candidate.rationale: An active ligand must be supported by at least two selected receptor conformations.
Two-hit active consensus with an explicit penalty for positively correlated receptor scores.
An active ligand must be supported by all three selected receptor conformations.
An active ligand counts when at least one selected receptor ranks it in the frozen early-rank band.
